crc standard patterns are not implemented for x86
For some architectures there are families of CRC instructions available to fill the role of __builtin_*_crc*_*() for specific configurations, which would be much more efficient than the code currently generated.

For example:https://godbolt.org/z/rn4jozq61As I recall Arm supports two different polynomials, and I think RISCV has an extension to support one.

And these extend to 8, 16, 32, and 64-bit input data types as well.


BTW, I'm going to post the same link again regarding the `constexpr` situation.
